caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet, rendered in grayscale pencil on paper. The bonnet is composed of a soft fabric, with embroidery on the main panel that features floral motifs and leaf patterns. Along the edge of the bonnet is a scalloped lace trim that gives the border a delicate, frilled appearance. There are additional small floral embroidery patterns on the side panel of the bonnet. At the bottom, a fabric ribbon is tied into a bow, with both ends of the ribbon hanging downward. The entire object is centered within a rectangular frame sketched near the edges of the paper. The shading in the drawing suggests folds and contours in the fabric, indicating a three-dimensional form. The background of the drawing is blank, leaving the focus entirely on the bonnet.
title: Night Cap
